{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "837d7e1d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Quickstart\n",
    "\n",
    "This workflow is for a user who wants to use a basic linear model without tuning and would like to generate and plot uncertainty bounds for a weather forecast of a specific city.\n",
    "\n",
    "### Imports"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "93e49bad",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from fue.config import Config\n",
    "from fue.data import Data\n",
    "from fue.forecast import Forecast\n",
    "from fue.models import LinearUncertaintyModel, MLUncertaintyModel"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4736a278",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Data Workflow\n",
    "\n",
    "Initialize Configuration (using the default settings from config.json) and Data objects"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "c7d049ad",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "config = Config()\n",
    "data = Data()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0bff74ee",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Read the historical raw dataset from disk to train a quick baseline model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "f396cc44",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "data.read_raw()\n",
    "dataset = data.generate_dataset()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1a039e07",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Train a Linear Model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4cb16440",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Extract the configured feature and target column names"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "03e8777c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "features = config.default_feature_columns\n",
    "targets = config.default_target_columns"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "ec14c0f0",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<fue.models.linear_model.LinearUncertaintyModel at 0x713112a2f770>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "linear_model = LinearUncertaintyModel(config=config)\n",
    "linear_model.fit(dataset, features, targets)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "69b93c65",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Train a Machine Learning Model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "8010258a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<fue.models.ml_model.MLUncertaintyModel at 0x7131126fb0e0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 6,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ml_model = MLUncertaintyModel(\n",
    "    config=config, hidden_layer_sizes=(32, 16), max_iter=1000, alpha=0.01, ensemble_size=5, seed=42\n",
    ")\n",
    "ml_model.fit(dataset, features, targets)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "683daea2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Generate a Forecast\n",
    "... for a specific city and for a certain number of days"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "3deae4e7",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "forecast = Forecast()\n",
    "forecast.fetch_forecast(location_name=\"aachen\", forecast_days=14, past_days=0)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c0101ddb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Use the uncertainty model to estimate uncertainty bounds and visualize them"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "6816254d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "forecast.compute_uncertainties(linear_model)\n",
    "forecast.plot(target_variables=[\"abs_diff__temperature_2m_max\", \"abs_diff__precipitation_sum\"])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "550a680b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now, we plot the uncertainty bounds using the machine learning model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "db62d8ba",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "forecast.compute_uncertainties(ml_model)\n",
    "forecast.plot(target_variables=[\"abs_diff__temperature_2m_max\", \"abs_diff__precipitation_sum\"])"
   ]
  }
 ],
